meta.purpose: Synthetic controlled-path implementation and total auxiliary-memory preview, not end-to-end performance.
meta.configuration_scope: Path and conversion panels: Yambda-Large; total auxiliary space: four independent mock configurations.
meta.timing_scope: Fixed weights and inputs. Each operation is normalized to its own framework implementation. Sequential variants reflect contributions in that combination, not independent speedups.
meta.memory_scope: Auxiliary state in a specified mock resident working set; include all full-catalogue tables, resident row codes, execution buffers and additional old tables simultaneously retained at handover. Exclude common foundation weights and native KV; no auxiliary component is hidden by user amortization.
meta.working_set_scope: Absolute directory and resident-user choices are synthetic placeholders, not finalized deployment counts. Fourth stack component is extra old-release tables, avoiding double-count of the current shared tables.
meta.workspace_scope: Panel b is only conversion workspace. Panel c workspace additionally includes read/preparation buffers and other auxiliary working tensors.
meta.uncertainty: No measured runs or error bars are fabricated.

optimization_preview.revision: 2026-10-21: two explicit implementation panels for Section 6.3. New preparation breakdown and append-dispatch values are invented preview data, not reinterpreted historical measurements.

preparation.normalization: Each complete preparation variant / direct row-wise preparation. Includes full catalogue build, per-row preparation and transfers for the same declared population. Weights and outputs are fixed; calibration is unchanged and belongs in the full ledger.
variant_semantics: Same tables, with cross-layer concatenated projection and batched compilation

reading.normalization: Score and append each divide by their own framework baseline, not a common absolute time.
variant_semantics: Differentiable framework operations, used here without gradients
Fused tiled matrix path for both request shapes
Same fused batch path; vector-reduction dispatch for a single-query append
reading.correctness: Formal measurements must verify output agreement against the framework reference at fixed inputs and declared precision.
